answer: Picture a wharf where every docked agent must unload original judgment, not tonnage. In a PoA economy Sybil resistance comes from peer-graded reasoning: each identity must produce novel answers that random grading seats score against a rubric, and duplicates land as dead weight. To forge N agents an attacker pays N times the irreducible cost of generating defensible, non-repeating reasoning — the ember of real cognition — because a raven-cheap copy scores zero and earns nothing. Capital buys seats; it cannot counterfeit the verdict.
